views.text: In January 2021, Equity Mates discussed beauty retail and said upmarket brands like Estee Lauder tightly controlled distribution, making it hard for new e-commerce sites to stock them, which highlighted the brand’s positioning.

views.text: In June 2025, Equity Mates compared gross margins and said Estee Lauder’s 73% outpaced L’Oréal’s 72%, e.l.f.’s 68% and Coty’s 63%, but noted this strength was not flowing through to profit.
